featuredProduct.title: Pallet Stretch Wrap – Cost-Optimized Packaging, Custom Manufactured
featuredProduct.subtitle: Produced on modern technology lines, our Pallet stretch wrap ensures high durability, optimal elasticity, and outstanding cargo protection during transport.
featuredProduct.feat1: Pallet stretch wrap with high tensile strength tightly wraps and secures goods on pallets, preventing displacement and collapse during transit.
featuredProduct.feat2: Pallet stretch wrap protects goods during transport and warehousing. Dust-proof, moisture-proof, keeping goods clean and dry.
featuredProduct.feat3: ULINK pallet machine wrap reduces packaging costs thanks to high stretchability, saving film per pallet while ensuring firm adhesion.
featuredProduct.feat4: We deliver quickly with modern logistics, meeting diverse size demands and complying with international quality standards.
featuredProduct.row2Desc: Pallet stretch film is an industrial packaging material used to secure and protect goods on pallets during transit and storage. The product features high self-adhesion, 300–400% stretchability, waterproofing, dustproofing, and UV resistance, keeping goods stable without displacement or damage. The film is produced on multi-layer cast extrusion lines utilizing the latest nano-layer technology, allowing the creation of ultra-thin films from 3 to 55 layers. The automatic PLC control system combined with continuous thickness sensors ensures product uniformity, saving raw materials by up to 30% compared to traditional technologies while maintaining superior mechanical strength.
